description.en: A god's-eye floor for DeepSeek Harness: every session as a pixel engineer with live progress.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的上帝视角工位视图：每个会话一位像素工程师，实时显示进度。

description.en: A compact always-on dock for DeepSeek Harness: which session is running, how far along, how many tokens, which files changed. Click a row to jump to that session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的常驻监控条：谁在跑、跑到第几步、烧了多少 token、改了哪些文件。点一行直接跳会话。
